caption:
NASA just awarded billions to build permanent bases on the Moon, but what if you actually lived there? For starters, day and night each last two entire weeks. During the brutal lunar night, temperatures plummet below minus two hundred degrees Fahrenheit, forcing your underground habitat to rely on nuclear power to keep you from freezing. Step outside, and without an atmosphere to stop micrometeorites or cosmic radiation, your suit is your only shield. Could you survive two weeks of lunar darkness? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: NASA unveils $10 billion in moon base contracts, new lunar missions and the 'PROMISE' of a nuclear-powered rover - Space
